description: This file contains unit tests for the BonjourEscapes decoding functionality in the OpenClawKit project, verifying correct handling of escape sequences in decoded strings.

methods.name: decodePassThrough
methods.description: Tests that decoding a string without escape sequences returns the original string.

methods.name: decodeSpaces
methods.description: Tests decoding of escape sequences representing spaces.

methods.name: decodeMultipleEscapes
methods.description: Tests decoding of multiple escape sequences within a string.

methods.name: decodeIgnoresInvalidEscapeSequences
methods.description: Ensures invalid escape sequences are preserved as-is.

methods.name: decodeUsesDecimalUnicodeScalarValue
methods.description: Tests decoding using decimal Unicode scalar escape sequences.
